Create the cover illustration for an illustrated folk-tale book, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: Golden autumn light on the Farm. In the foreground, the Farmhand sits on the grey pole fence at the bottom of the meadow, grinning slyly and tossing a big silver coin in the air. Behind him, up the meadow, the Wife stands in the farmhouse door and beckons with a secret smile, and Pål tiptoes across the yard towards her on the toes of his polished shoes, licking his lips.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- the Farmhand: A very skinny, quick lad of about fifteen with a mousy-brown pudding-bowl haircut, a narrow, sunburnt face with a pointed chin, a wide, sly grin and quick green eyes that miss nothing. He wears a baggy, faded brick-red homespun shirt and patched brown knee breeches that are too short for him, so his bony shins show, and goes barefoot. - Pål: A soft, round-bellied young man of about twenty-five, shorter than most, with a round, pale, clean-shaven face, plump pink cheeks, a small upturned nose, big, droopy brown eyes and wavy light-brown hair combed into a proud swoop over his forehead. He wears a short brown jacket over a tight lemon-yellow waistcoat with shiny brass buttons straining over his belly, a floppy pink silk neckerchief tied in a big bow, grey knee breeches and polished black buckled shoes, with a carved wooden spoon in his breast pocket.
